title: Invertibility of the open-immersion coefficient unit
statement: Let $j:Y\to X$ be an open immersion of schemes and $M$ an $\mathcal O_X$-module. Let $U_X$ and $U_Y$ forget modules to abelian sheaves. The abelian adjunct of the module pullback unit $M\to j_*j^*M$ [def-pc-flat-cohomology-comparison], namely $j^{-1}U_X(M)\to U_Y(j^*M)$, is an isomorphism. This holds for every module, without flatness or quasi-coherence.

source.place: Lemma 18.20.1, lemma-localize-morphism-ringed-sites, final parenthetical: inverse image and module pullback agree for localization morphisms; open-subscheme specialization.

proof.text: Lift the image/preimage adjunction on opens to abelian sheaves with Adjunction.sheafPushforwardContinuous. Its left adjoint is naive restriction, definitionally the underlying abelian sheaf of module restriction. Its unit is definitionally the image under toSheaf of the module restriction unit (check each open). Compare this left adjoint with invImage using Adjunction.leftAdjointUniq; the comparison is an isomorphism.

Apply the abelian adjunction hom equivalence to the coefficient unit and to the composite of the leftAdjointUniq comparison with the forgotten restrictFunctorIsoPullback comparison. Naturality on the right and homEquiv_leftAdjointUniq_hom_app identify the latter adjunct with the forgotten restriction unit followed by the forgotten pushforward comparison. The equality pullbackUnit_eq_of_isOpenImmersion identifies it with the forgotten module pullback unit, which is the adjunct of coefficientUnit by definition. Injectivity gives equality of the coefficient unit with a composite of two isomorphisms; infer its IsIso instance.

proof_origin.place: Localization equality in the final parenthetical; Lean realization by K1 using Adjunction.sheafPushforwardContinuous and leftAdjointUniq, and the existing module restriction unit comparison.
